page_title: NIC 2-0 LIL | Nice v Lille 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' 2 - 0 Isak Jansson (Nice) collects a sweet pass and lashes the ball into the top left corner. It couldn't have gone in a better place.
87' Romain Perraud (Lille) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
85' The game has come to an end for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ngalayel Mukau (Lille).
85' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Charles Vanhoutte and he is replaced by Morgan Sanson (Nice).

83' Tiago Gouveia (Nice) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies yards wide of the left-hand post.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille). Bastien Dechepy doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
81' It is time for a substitution. Olivier Giroud (Lille) is on for Benjamin Andre.
81' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
80' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.
78' Tiago Gouveia (Nice) receives a yellow card.
78' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' Benjamin Andre (Lille) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Bastien Dechepy's book.
70' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Broholm (Lille) replacing Hamza Igamane.
69' Here's the change. Felix Correia leaves the pitch and Osame Sahraoui (Lille) comes on as a substitute.
69' A substitution has been made. Ayyoub Bouaddi goes off and Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) comes on.
69' We are about to witness a subsitution. Isak Jansson (Nice) for Salis Abdul Samed.
68' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Jeremie Boga is replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
68' Substitution. Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) has come on for Sofiane Diop.
66' This shall not pass! Nathan Ngoy (Lille) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
63' Romain Perraud (Lille) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
54' Hamza Igamane (Lille) latches onto a pass, beats his marker but shoots well wide of the right post.
51' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
51' Thomas Meunier (Lille) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Felix Correia (Lille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
40' What was Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
35' The foul by Antoine Mendy (Nice) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Bastien Dechepy.
35' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) for a tough tackle.
34' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the corner kick, but Yehvann Diouf reads it well and stops the effort.
34' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
32' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
29' 1 - 0 With a cheeky finish ala Antonin Panenka, Sofiane Diop (Nice) scores from the penalty spot.
28' Sofiane Diop (Nice) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
27' Bastien Dechepy blows the whistle, Arnaud Bodart (Lille) is penalised for a foul. Nice are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
26' Lille take a short corner kick.

26' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) jumps for a cross and glances a header towards the roof of the net, but it's meat and drink for Yehvann Diouf and he comfortably saves. Good work from Lille as they win a corner.
25' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
25' Hamza Igamane (Lille) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Lille win a corner.
22' Sofiane Diop (Nice) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
17' A quickly taken corner by Nice.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nice.
15' Jeremie Boga (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lille.
11' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Felix Correia (Lille) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. Lille win a corner kick.
7' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

6' Yehvann Diouf pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop an accurate header from the corner kick by Thomas Meunier (Lille) going under the crossbar. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lille.
6' The linesman makes the right call and Lille will have a corner.
3' Neat passing move from Nice in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lille will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Bastien Dechepy.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
Show lineups
Hello and welcome to our live text commentary! We will provide you with instant updates of everything that happens in the match. The starting lineups will be announced very soon.
